links.comparator_used: Matched no-retrieval condition (model answering from training knowledge alone) for two 8B models, Qwen3-VL-8B and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B
links.outcome: Clinician-scored clinical accuracy, patient safety and faithfulness on a 50-question perioperative IBD benchmark
links.effect: Accuracy: Qwen3 Δ=+0.44 (P<0.001); DeepSeek Δ=+0.21 (P=0.09); model-by-retrieval interaction not significant. Patient safety: no reliable benefit. Faithfulness: Qwen3 Δ=-0.24 (P<0.001), with a significant model-by-retrieval interaction.
links.tradeoff: Faithfulness fell significantly with RAG on Qwen3. Authentic retrieved references (all 236 PMID verifications existed in PubMed) could accompany incorrect or unsafe conclusions.
links.quote: RAG significantly improved Qwen3 accuracy (Δ=+0.44, P<0.001) but not DeepSeek accuracy (Δ=+0.21, P=0.09), and the model-by-retrieval interaction for accuracy was not significant.
